tools.name: buddypunch_list_employees
tools.description: List employees of the company: name, email, active and manager flags, hire and termination dates, time zone. Needs the employees:read scope. GET /employee.

tools.name: buddypunch_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with pay amount, break rule, overtime type and time entry mode. Needs employees:read. GET /employee/{id}.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_locations
tools.description: List the company's work locations (name, address, geofence settings). Needs locations:read. GET /location.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_pay_periods
tools.description: List pay periods, optionally for one pay period schedule. Needs payperiods:read. GET /payPeriod.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_punches
tools.description: List the clock punches of one time card (punch in/out times, location, department). Needs punches:read. GET /punch.

tools.name: buddypunch_get_punch
tools.description: Get one punch by id, with its punch in and out times and location. Needs punches:read. GET /punch/{id}.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_time_entries
tools.description: List the time entries of one time card (worked hours by job and date). Needs timeentries:read. GET /timeEntry.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_time_cards
tools.description: List the time cards of one pay period: one per employee, with approval status. Needs timecards:read. GET /timeCard.

tools.name: buddypunch_get_time_card_details
tools.description: Get one time card's totals: regular, overtime, double time, time off, paid and unpaid breaks, approval status. Needs timecards:read. GET /timeCard/{id}/details.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_time_off
tools.description: List time off entries, optionally for one employee or a date range. Needs pto:read. GET /timeOff.

tools.name: buddypunch_list_time_off_types
tools.description: List the time off (PTO) earning types, with their ids for buddypunch_create_time_off_request. Needs pto:read. GET /timeOffType.

tools.name: buddypunch_get_schedule
tools.description: Get the published shifts for a date range, optionally filtered by location, job code, position or employee. Needs shifts:read. GET /schedule.

tools.name: buddypunch_punch_in
tools.description: Record a clock-in for an employee now or at punchDateTime. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /punch/in.

tools.name: buddypunch_punch_out
tools.description: Record a clock-out for an employee now or at punchDateTime. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /punch/out.

tools.name: buddypunch_start_break
tools.description: Start a break for an employee under one break rule. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /break/start.

tools.name: buddypunch_end_break
tools.description: End the open break of an employee. Changes the time records. Needs punches:write. POST /break/end.

tools.name: buddypunch_create_time_off_request
tools.description: Create a time off request for an employee: hours per day or per date range, with a time off type. Needs pto:write. POST /timeOff.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buddypunch_list_employees, buddypunch_end_break · Private data: buddypunch_punch_in, buddypunch_punch_out, buddypunch_start_break, buddypunch_end_break · Public sink: buddypunch_list_employees, buddypunch_punch_in, buddypunch_punch_out, buddypunch_start_break, buddypunch_end_break, buddypunch_create_time_off_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buddypunch_list_employees, buddypunch_end_break · Private data: buddypunch_punch_in, buddypunch_punch_out, buddypunch_start_break, buddypunch_end_break · Public sink: buddypunch_list_employees, buddypunch_punch_in, buddypunch_punch_out, buddypunch_start_break, buddypunch_end_break, buddypunch_create_time_off_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
